title: Entries of a list of powers
statement: For natural numbers $b,L,j$, suppose $j$ is less than the length of the list whose entries, indexed by $k=0,\ldots,L-1$, are the integers $b^k$. The entry at index $j$ of that list is the integer $b^j$.
hypotheses_covered: The index $j$ is less than the length of the power list
